title: 3-Day Maasai Mara Safari
summary: Game drives across the Mara plains, full-board tented camp, and a Maasai village visit.

days.t: Nairobi → Maasai Mara. Afternoon game drive.
Full-day game drive with picnic lunch in the reserve.
Morning game drive, return to Nairobi.

title: 5-Day Amboseli & Tsavo
summary: Elephants beneath Kilimanjaro, then the red dust of Tsavo East and West.

days.t: Amboseli → Tsavo West, afternoon game drive.
Tsavo West → Tsavo East, full-day game drive.
Morning game drive, return to Nairobi.

title: 4-Day Diani Beach Escape
summary: White sand, turquoise water and coral reef snorkeling on Kenya's south coast.

days.t: Free day — optional kitesurfing or dhow cruise.

title: 3-Day Watamu Marine Park
summary: Coral gardens, green turtles, and vibrant reef snorkeling in Watamu.

days.t: Mida Creek mangrove kayak + turtle watch.

title: 2-Day Arabuko Sokoke Birding
summary: Endemic birding in Africa's largest coastal dry forest with a specialist guide.

days.t: Morning forest walk, afternoon Mida Creek.
